rules.statement: Section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code, as amended by Act No. 53 of 1980, includes 'payment of money or delivery of other property'.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code which applied was amended by Act No. 53 of 1980. The words "payment of money or delivery of other property" in section 337(1) before amendment should be read ejusdem as they are referable to items A (decree to pay money) and B (decree to deliver movable property) of the classification of decrees mentioned in section 217. Item C in the classification 192 refers to decrees "to yield up possession of immovable property". The word 'delivery' is appropriate to movable property. At the time he obtained judgment in his favour, the judgment ‐ creditor was not inhibited by any period of time to apply for execution of a decree commanding the judgment ‐ debtor to yield up possession of immovable property. rules.statement: The term 'delivery' in the context of a decree refers specifically to movable property, distinct from immovable property which requires a 'yield up possession' order.
